name: TaxHacker
description: Self-hosted AI accounting app that extracts data from receipts and invoices, categorises it and handles currency conversion.
whatItDoes: Lets freelancers and small businesses upload photos or PDFs of receipts and invoices and get structured, categorised transactions ready for tax reporting.
howItWorks: A web app sends uploaded documents to a configured LLM with customisable prompts to pull out fields, then stores results in its database. It is deployed with Docker Compose.
